name: Celebrations
short: Birthdays (hoisted role, wondercoin gift, posts) and join-anniversary shout-outs.
description: Members save their birthday with `.birthday set March 14` (year optional). On the day (Pacific time) they get a hoisted birthday role and a configurable wondercoin gift, a birthday embed is posted in the chat channel with a star reaction for the starboard, and a temporary post goes to #announcements that is deleted when the day ends. Also posts a daily shout-out for members celebrating their join anniversary. Lurkers are skipped.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each member's birthday (month, day and, only if they provide it, year) and the date they were last celebrated. Members can remove it with `.birthday remove`; it is deleted on a Red data-deletion request.
install_msg: Set it up with `.celebrations channel #cuddle`, `.celebrations announcements #announcements`, `.celebrations makerole` (or `.celebrations role @role`). Members use `.birthday set March 14`. See `.celebrations` for all settings.
author: evacfk
